newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool slow, prices unchanged to easier.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool slow, prices unchanged to easier.

text.p: New business was slow and difficult at the Bradford wool market with no chance of selling at firm prices and margins constantly under pressure.
Easter holidays also continued to affect the market with some firms still closed and individuals taking breaks.
An encouraging feature was a good call for deliveries which kept up hopes of more new business to come. But there is no sign of willingness to pay higher prices by those at or toward the retail end.

Competitive imports are encouraged by strength in sterling and although this also reduced the price of imported wool it fails to make any significant difference by the time manufacturing costs are added.

Price as quoted are unchanged to lower, according to individual decisions on whether it is pointless to alter them until world values are tested or whether the latest currency-related calculations should be taken into acount.
